categorisation: This gazette contains both the naming of a specific individual (President Gotabaya Rajapaksa) and detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities, institutional frameworks, and specific laws/acts to be implemented by various government bodies. The content includes both "who" (the President) and "what" (detailed responsibilities and legal frameworks for multiple institutions including the Board of Investment, Colombo Port City Economic Commission, and various Presidential Task Forces), making it a Hybrid Gazette according to the classification rules.
